text:
Aisha: Puzzle cafe this Sunday? Or movie night? Up for either. Thinking Knotty Puzzles at 2pm or the 7pm indie screening. Thoughts?
Ben: Puzzle cafe! Haven't done one in ages :brain:
Noah: Movie night for me if it's the indie — which film is it?
Priya: Both sound great. Leaning puzzle cafe though. Can we bring snacks? :cookie:
Ben: Could do a doubleheader? Puzzle at 2 then movie at 7 — ambitious but fun :raised_hands:
Aisha: Haha doubleheader would be epic. @Noah can you check Knotty Puzzles availability and the cinema seats?
Noah: On it. Knotty has an open slot at 2:30 but not many tables left. Cinema is showing 'A Quiet Storm' at 7:15, ~20 seats left.
Priya: If Knotty is tight we can do the cafe and skip the movie. My vote: puzzle first.
Ben: Vote: puzzle (and maybe movie if seats left) :thumbsup:
Noah: Vote: movie (I could be swayed — cafe + movie is fine)
Aisha: Okay looks like puzzle > movie by a hair. I'm cool with grabbing a knotty table at 2:30 if everyone can make it.
Priya: I can make 2:30. I'll bring a small snack pack.
Ben: 2:30 works for me. Meet at 2:15 outside?
calendar-bot: Event created: "Puzzle Cafe (Knotty Puzzles)" Sunday 14:30 — Tentative. Invited: Aisha, Ben, Noah, Priya.
Aisha: Sweet — meet at 2:15 outside Knotty. If cinema looks good after, we can decide on the spot. See ya! :smile:
